column9: The full git map is captured through runAnalyzer without increasing maxBuffer. That wrapper uses execFileSync's default 1 MiB stdout limit, so repositories whose history map exceeds that size fail with ENOBUFS and return available:false despite successful analyzer availability. Set an appropriate output limit or use a file/stream interface for the full map.

The documented adjustForAi option is never read or passed to the analyzer. Calling collectGitData({adjustForAi:true}) therefore returns exactly the same bus factor as the default, silently ignoring the requested adjustment for AI commits. Implement the adjustment or remove the unsupported option from the public contract.
